description: Land Aquisition - Gangodawila, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District Sec. 39 (1)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the divestment and revocation of land allotments, including specific plot descriptions, boundaries, and locations. The content focuses on land redemption notices and property transfers, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land-related administrative action rather than constituting a government personnel or hybrid classification.
